[EN] We're not too far from {@Rgn:78001}, but that's not enough to deter the argons.

We've got to keep fighting. We can't lose the foundry—no matter what.
[ES] No estamos muy lejos de {@Rgn:78001}, pero eso no basta para disuadir a los argones.

Tenemos que seguir luchando. No podemos perder la fundición, sin importar qué.
